headline: 9 killed as small plane crashes near Trump's Florida resort
summary: A Learjet 60 crashed near Cresthaven, Florida, killing all nine people on board. The aircraft was en route to the Bahamas from Austin, Texas.
details: A small business jet crashed near Cresthaven, Florida, killing all nine occupants on Sunday afternoon. The aircraft, a Learjet 60, was traveling from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas when it went down approximately 9 miles from President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort.

The crash occurred around 12:50 PM local time, creating a large crater on a residential street and scattering debris across the roadway. Images from the scene show remnants of the plane, concrete fragments, and signs of fire.

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) confirmed the flight's origin and destination. Investigations by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) are underway, with the FAA sending a team to assist. The Florida Governor described the crash footage as "chilling," likening the plane's descent to a missile.

Officials stated that no injuries or fatalities were reported on the ground. However, the crash caused significant infrastructure damage, including water pipelines, and an adjacent trailer park housing approximately 600 residents was evacuated. The affected road is expected to remain closed for at least 30 days.
The incident occurred amidst stormy weather, with heavy rain reported at the time of the press conference. President Trump had departed from a nearby airport about an hour before the crash.

headline: Teacher needs 50 lakh BDT for liver transplant in India
summary: Sadhan Chakraborty, a teacher from Noakhali, is battling liver cirrhosis and urgently needs financial aid for a life-saving surgery in Delhi.
details: Sadhan Chakraborty, a 43-year-old teacher at Maijdee Balika Vidyaniketan, is suffering from liver cirrhosis.
Doctors in Delhi, India, have advised an urgent liver transplant to save his life.
His wife has been selected as a potential liver donor, but the cost of the procedure is estimated at approximately 50 lakh BDT.
The family has already spent their savings on expensive treatments and is now facing a severe financial crisis.
Sadhan Chakraborty has appealed to people from all walks of life for urgent financial assistance to fund the surgery.
Donations can be sent to Pubali Bank Ltd, Maijdee Bazar Branch, Account No: 4908101002540, Routing No: 175751547.
Financial aid can also be provided via bKash or Nagad at 01717589193.
